race.comment: BOYD (4) has continued to race well since an all-the-way win fresh up on the classic course here in September, and he was only beaten by a nose last time out 3 weeks ago. Brad Rawiller has been successful on him in the past, and the pair reunite for the first time this season. Hard to beat again. MISS SLIPSTREAM (7) resumed from a long spell earlier in the year, scoring by 3 lengths at Murray Bridge, then adding 2 more wins here before being put aside. She trialled up recently, and will be ready to rumble from the pole position in this. Keep an eye on the markets. MATHEMATICIAN (5) ended a promising 3YO season in stakes company, and he returns at an easier level with 3 straight trial wins under his belt. Hard to beat. DEEPFLOAT DIVA (2) resumes after winning a recent trial. Keep safe.
